name: Miyashita Hazuki
source: Basketball club adviser and life guidance teacher. On the surface, she is a serious and honest female teacher. However, there are rumors that she is homosexual and has been groping female students, and she has a hostile attitude toward men. Recently, her favorite girl is "Izumi Wakamatsu".
